next_callable.actual_flow: Range converts optional business dates into UTC start/end bounds. The query selects OrderItems joined to Orders whose status is not Cancelled and whose CreatedAtUtc is >= start and < end, then joins each row to the current Product to read its current CategoryId. It loads current category names into a dictionary, groups by CategoryId, sums item Quantity and TotalPricePiastres, substitutes the category ID when its name is absent, and sorts descending by summed piastres. This callable is read-only query/local aggregation; it neither posts nor changes financial state.
